description: Today's digest for one reader, written from the <run> bundle. One call per run.

title.description: Thematic title of the day, at most 10 words, no date, in the requested language.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences on what today's papers are about, as a whole.

clusters.description: Groups of 2 or more papers that genuinely overlap. Empty array if none do. Each paper is in at most one cluster.

name.description: Short name of the shared problem, 2-6 words.

paper_ids.description: At least 2 ids from the bundle, copied verbatim.

narrative.description: Markdown that connects the papers; every claim cites its paper as [id].

papers.description: Exactly one entry per paper in the bundle, in bundle order, ids copied verbatim.

id.description: The paper's id, copied verbatim from the bundle.

cluster_id.description: The id of the cluster that lists this paper, or "" if unclustered.

essence.description: 2-3 sentences: the contribution, at the requested explanation level.

detail.description: Markdown: method, key equations in $...$, headline numbers against the baselines named in the text.

why_it_matters.description: Why this matters to this reader's profile, 1-2 sentences.

caveats.description: What the text does not show or support, or "" if nothing worth saying.

figure_index.description: index of the figure in this paper's <figures> that best explains the method, or 0 for none.

mermaid.description: Mermaid flowchart or sequenceDiagram body without code fences, or "" when the method has no real flow of 3 or more components.

hf_section.description: One entry per paper listed in <hf_papers>; [] when it is (none).

one_line.description: One line on what the paper does, from what <hf_papers> gives.

trend_notes.description: A topic that recurs across <recent_clusters> and today, or "" when nothing does.
